lifecycle.activation_contract: Extension Manager verifies RESEARCH_MANIFEST.json, forwards the hash-bound experimental B16-to-8+8 policy, and StateAxis admits only the matching host contract.
lifecycle.rollback_contract: Disable the extension; StateAxis then removes the 10 ms dynamic batch window and clears the worker dual-microbatch environment before spawn.

out_of_scope: automatic inheritance from StateAxis aggregate evidence
